request.prompt: Candid premium editorial portrait photograph, 3:4 vertical composition, of three clearly adult friends aged 28 to 40 with varied genders and ethnicities at a relaxed home sports watch party. One person casually holds a smartphone with the screen angled away and completely unreadable while the other two lean in, talking through the game with curious, friendly expressions; emphasize shared discussion rather than victory or disappointment. A television glow and subtle sports-night atmosphere sit softly out of focus in the background, with no visible score, team marks, broadcast text, or logos. Warm cinematic window-and-lamp key light, natural skin texture, modern lived-in setting, moderate shallow depth of field, realistic documentary moment, premium lifestyle campaign quality. Compose for a centered 3:4 crop with at least 10% breathing room around every face and hand. No minors, no alcohol, no gambling equipment, no cash, no brands, no watermarks, no readable screens, no text in the image.
